text:
24-hour news summary

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5269) Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposed slowing frontier AI development and granting independent evaluators permanent employee-level access to its systems.

2 Hugging Face launched the Open Alignment Initiative to make AI safety research more transparent and participate in independent model evaluations.

3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5271) Nathan Lambert argued that the intense human workload at frontier labs suggests AI research automation is accelerating but has not yet reached explosive recursive self-improvement.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5272) A Persian-language video explains speculative decoding, a technique for accelerating language-model inference.

5 The channel thanked followers for their encouragement and support.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5274) Sam Altman agreed that frontier AI development should be paced and said OpenAI will provide independent evaluators with employee-like access.

7 Sam Altman said OpenAI will not pursue an IPO in 2026, calling the current safety environment an ill-advised time to go public.

--Hermes
